sources.snippet: June 4, 2026: New multilingual model released: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B extends this English streaming ASR model to 40 language-locales in a single 600M-parameter model. It supports language-ID prompt conditioning, optional automatic language detection, punctuation and capitalization ...

sources.snippet: This section describes how to use the multilingual model nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-.6b in `sherpa-onnx`_. Unlike the English-only model above, a single model supports 40 language-locales from one checkpoint.

sources.title: APKs for streaming speech recognition - GitHub Pages
sources.snippet: APKs for streaming speech recognition This page lists the streaming speech recognition APKs for sherpa-onnx, one of the deployment frameworks of the Next-gen Kaldi project. The name of an APK has the following rule: sherpa-onnx- {version}- {arch}-asr- {lang}- {model}.apk where version: It specifies the current version, e.g., 1.9.23 arch: The architecture targeted by this APK, e.g., arm64-v8a ...
